prompt: In hearing, what happens just before sound reaches the inner ear?

options.text: The eardrum vibrates and three tiny bones pass the movement on

explanation: Sound waves vibrate the eardrum; the ossicles — hammer, anvil and stirrup — concentrate that movement and pass it into the fluid-filled cochlea.
